title: Open iframe links in a new tab
body: Clicking a citation or other URL inside the HTML viewer iframe currently navigates *within* the iframe. Most of those destinations refuse to be embedded (`X-Frame-Options` / CSP), so the link appears broken and the document you were reading is replaced. This change intercepts those clicks in `.html-viewer-frame` and `.design-preview-frame` and opens them in a new tab. Same-document hash jumps (`#section`) still stay in the iframe so table-of-contents and footnotes keep working. The click handler cannot use `instanceof Element` on iframe nodes (they live in a different JS realm). It identifies elements by `nodeType` and marks external anchors `target="_blank"` in the capture phase. **Testing** - Unit tests for stay-in-frame vs open-externally URL rules - Viewer/layout HTML includes the interceptor script - Manual: external `example.com` link opens in a new tab; iframe keeps the original document; in-page `#sources` still scrolls ![Iframe still shows the original document after clicking an external link](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-4625afa2-fefe-42f9-9f46-2c40bb390924) ![example.com opened in a new tab](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-41a91d94-a90b-477a-8239-2ce8ea69c28f)
